claimAirdrop(uint256).details: Score is NOT recorded here. Score recorded in settleAirdrop()

isAirdropHeld(address).details: Convenience view for frontends — avoids unnecessary tx reversions.

params.wallet: The wallet whose loan is being defaulted.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

takeLoan(uint256).details: No ETH is transferred — pure reputation simulation.         Score change only happens on repay or default, not on open.         One active loan per wallet enforced — prevents double-counting.

params.amount: Notional loan size (any non-zero value). Stored for                 event visibility — not used in score calculation.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

HOLD_PERIOD().notice: Minimum time a wallet must hold an airdrop to earn +15.         If settled before this, wallet earns -20 (dumped).

NFT_COOLDOWN().notice: Cooldown between consecutive mintNFT() calls per wallet.

PROPOSAL_COOLDOWN().notice: Cooldown between consecutive submitProposal() calls per wallet.

VOTE_COOLDOWN().notice: Cooldown between consecutive castVote() calls per wallet.

castVote().notice: Simulate casting a DAO vote — records +10 reputation.

claimAirdrop(uint256).notice: Claim a simulated airdrop — starts the 30-day hold timer.

getActiveLoan(address).notice: Returns the active loan amount for `wallet`. 0 = no loan.

getAirdropAmount(address).notice: Returns the pending airdrop amount for `wallet`. 0 = none.

getAirdropClaimTime(address).notice: Returns the airdrop claim timestamp for `wallet`. 0 = none.

getNextNftMintTime(address).notice: Returns timestamp when wallet can mintNFT() again. 0 = now.

getNextProposalTime(address).notice: Returns timestamp when wallet can submitProposal() again. 0 = now.

getNextVoteTime(address).notice: Returns timestamp when wallet can castVote() again. 0 = now.

isAirdropHeld(address).notice: Returns true if `wallet` can settle their airdrop with +15.

markDefault(address).notice: Mark a wallet's loan as defaulted — records -50 reputation.

mintNFT().notice: Simulate minting an NFT — records +5 reputation.

repayLoan().notice: Repay an active loan — records +30 reputation.

settleAirdrop().notice: Settle an airdrop — held 30+ days → +15, dumped early → -20.

submitProposal().notice: Simulate submitting a DAO proposal — records +25 reputation.
